mentions.name: Sprouts/Gardener
mentions.description: A self-hosting platform that makes self-hosting possible and easy without Linux sysadmin skills. The current version focuses on static site hosting, with templates, zero-config localhost preview, and one button to publish changes live.
mentions.problem: Self-hosting is difficult for people without Linux sysadmin skills
mentions.audience: People who want to self-host without Linux sysadmin skills
mentions.source_excerpt:
Sprouts/Gardener: a project to make self-hosting possible (and easy) without linux sysadmin skills

https://judi.systems/sprouts/

Current version focuses on static site hosting, with templates and zero-config localhost preview, one button to publish changes live.
